# SAML Negative Corpus Generator Notes

These fixtures are intentionally small, reviewable stand-ins for the attack
classes listed in section 16: XSW-A through XSW-H, XXE attempts, duplicate IDs,
bad recipient, expiry, replay, and IdP-initiated payloads.

The full production corpus should be regenerated from signed SimpleSAMLphp
responses by applying each transformation to a known-good response and then
checking that the ACS strict-order validator rejects it with the documented
sub-reason. Keep the fixture names stable because both
`tests/saml_negative_corpus.rs` and `scripts/seed-fuzz-corpus.sh` depend on
them.
